messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: elevated 5xx + timeouts observed on streaming path /v1/stream across multiple regions. Triggering oncall.

sam: noticed a sharp uptick in 502/504s and HTTP/2 GOAWAYs starting ~15:02 UTC. Affects us-west & eu-west.

maria: backend stream workers show thread stalls and epoll timeouts. Some workers log `epoll_wait timed out` then close upstreams. No CPU/GPU spike.

ben: i'm oncall. please add quick mitigations: 1) enable fallback sync generation for high-retry clients 2) temporarily soften proxy timeouts 3) isolate suspect worker pool.

rita: created a canary header `x-live-fallback: 1` and mapping so SDKs can opt into sync fallback. applying to edge now.

gateway-bot: Edge rule applied. Example diff: 
```
route "/v1/stream" -> stream-proxy
if header("x-live-fallback") == "1" then proxy -> generate-sync
```

sam: rolling that to a small percentage of customers for fast feedback. immediate metrics: canary showing fewer disconnects.

maria: investigating builds — abnormal kernel/epoll behavior after recent netlib patch rolled at 14:48. One subpool (stream-pool-c) running linux kernel compat layer build b-2026 shows elevated epoll stalls.

ben: can we cordon that pool and shift new sessions elsewhere?

rita: cordon in progress: marking stream-pool-c drain mode and rebalancing new sessions to pool-a/pool-b. Also bumped proxy keepalive 30->70s and upstream connect timeout 5->12s.

sam: quick query: `increase(stream_errors_total[10m]) by (reason)` -> shows 55% client_cancel, 35% upstream_reset, 10% proxy_timeout. Client cancels indicate SDKs giving up; hope fallbacks reduce that.

maria: started rolling back netlib patch on the affected pool. rollback target: netlib v1.3.1 -> v1.3.0. deploying now to stream-pool-c nodes.

~ 8m later ~

maria: rollback finished for pool-c. epoll timeouts dropping in logs. upstream resets down.

sam: cluster 5xx rate fell from 18% -> 3.2% since mitigations + rollback. client cancels also down ~45%.

ben: customer impact assessment: dozens of streaming sessions experienced mid-stream disconnects and partial outputs for ~20-35 minutes. Most clients retried, some saw degraded UX. CS please contact top 10 affected customers.

cs-team: drafting message now: short incident note, timeline, mitigations, ETA for postmortem. Will send to affected accounts within 1 hour.

rita: added temporary quota: per-api-key concurrent_streams limit of 25; excess gets 429 + header `x-fallback-suggest: 1`. Also enabled short-circuit for long-poll clients to fall back to non-stream sync generation.

ben: good. handoff plan: i'll remain until 15:15 UTC, then hand to maria for the deep postmortem and root cause analysis. if errors >3% spike again, escalate paging.

incident-bot: Incident created with severity=high, start_ts=3100003333, mitigations=[fallback-header, proxy-timeout-bump, pool-c-rollback, per-key-quota], owners=[ben,maria,rita], followup=postmortem and CI test for epoll/netlib.

sam: notes for postmortem: add regression test that simulates slow epoll wakes and forced netlib stalls; validate SDK backoff behavior; ensure datastore timeouts surfaced earlier.

maria: will capture affected build IDs, node lists, and timelines. adding reproduction in staging by injecting artificial epoll delays. scheduling postmortem review tomorrow.

ben: closing live mitigation thread. incident remains open for postmortem. thanks all for fast moves. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Annotated incident record updated.
